notes: Level 90 Fischl with level 90 Prototype Crescent, weak-point passive inactive: base ATK 244 + 510 = 754; fixed ATK ratio 0.24 + 0.413 = 0.653.
Guide supports ATK/Electro/crit, Golden Troupe, and 120-140% ER for off-field Burst every rotation; 120 is the lower endpoint.
Skill-only, non-Quicken ranking proxy. Off-field bonus assumed active for evaluated hits; transition hits and Burst damage excluded.
blockers: Verify skill-specific bonuses, off-field activation, snapshots, and independent build rankings before deletion use.

notes: Level 90 C0 Xingqiu with level 90 Favonius Sword: base ATK 202 + 454 = 656; ascension ATK ratio 0.24; weapon ER addition 0.613.
A4 Hydro DMG ratio 0.20 is a fixed bonus. Guide supports ER/ATK sands, Hydro goblet, crit circlet, and Emblem.
190% ER selects the lower endpoint of the guide's C0-C5 Favonius range, assuming reliable procs and unspecified average team energy.
Burst-only ranking proxy; excludes Skill damage and team defensive utility.
blockers: Resolve team/rotation and Favonius proc reliability; verify ER-dependent Burst bonus and cap, then compare complete build rankings.

notes: Level 90 Barbara with level 90 TTDS: base HP 9787; fixed HP ratio 0.24 + 0.352 = 0.592. TTDS buffs the next teammate, not Barbara's ATK.
Guide supports HP/HP/healing and Maiden for pure healing; no per-rotation Burst requirement.
Healing proxy omits talent flat healing and coefficients; active Maiden incoming-healing effect is distinct from outgoing healing bonus.
blockers: Current proxy expression omits received healing and talent flat terms; encode those contributions and their sourced coefficients; do not treat this as a validated Maiden-vs-other-set comparison.

notes: Same level, weapon, and fixed stats as Barbara Maiden case; documented two-piece healing/HP alternatives are separate established coverage.
Only healing is targeted; Ocean-Hued Clam four-piece damage and its cap are outside this scenario.
blockers: Verify flat healing terms and reference rankings; cannot compare team damage or four-piece Clam utility.

notes: Level 90 Zhongli with level 90 Black Tassel: base HP 14695; weapon HP ratio 0.469. Burst not required each rotation.
Guide supports HP/HP/HP and two HP sets for shield health; maps to Tenacity plus Vourukasha.
HP-only shield proxy excludes talent flat absorption, Fortify, shield-strength effects, and teammate support value.
blockers: Validate shield absorption and active-character shield strength; support sets need a different objective.

notes: Upper endpoint of the documented 120-140% range; speculative energy sensitivity within the same role, not a new character build.
blockers: Inherits parent blockers; exact team energy still unspecified.

notes: Upper endpoint of the documented 190-220% C0-C5 Favonius range; samples an uncertain team-energy case.
500 flat ATK is deliberately assumed sensitivity input, not a sourced Bennett value or another named teammate buff.
blockers: Inherits parent blockers; validate sensitivity across more than one buff level.

Tenacity, Noblesse, Deepwood, and Viridescent team value needs teammate utility and activation conditions, not only holder damage/healing.
Healing amount, accumulation windows, received healing, and damage caps need additional formula support.

emblem-burst-bonus.description: At four pieces, Burst DMG bonus is one quarter of effective ER, capped at 0.75 (75%).
